name: example
_about: A neutral brand that shows the shape: five colours, two faces, a mark and a banner. Copy this folder under brands/<your-name>/, change the values, keep the keys. vkit brand <name> applies it to a video; vkit brand --check reports what it does to the contrast rules.
_colours: ground is the stage; ink is the text on it (4.5:1 against ground); primary is the accent and the kicker (3:1 against ground); secondary is the second kind colour; highlight is the stroke, the outline and the pointer ring, which sit on the ground and on white product screens, so it holds 3:1 on both. Leave a colour empty and the look or the theme default stays.
_faces: display is headings, labels and the mark; text is sentences, card bodies and the explanation card. System stacks only, until a shipped face has a licence row (C-TYPE-15).
_mark: when: never, opener (the first `seconds`), close (the last `seconds`), both, always (the whole run, hidden while a recreated screen is up so it never covers the product), watermark (the whole run, over the screen too). where: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right; every corner sits inside title safe (96 and 54 px) and above the caption band (200 px). size is the mark's height in pixels; file is an image in this folder (optional) shown to the left of the text.
_banner: A strip across the frame. where: top or bottom (bottom sits above the caption band). fill is one of the five colour names or a colour; ink is a colour, or auto for black or white, whichever holds the better ratio on the fill.
